name: visualize
description: Generate, explore, and refine beautiful on-brand HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards.

interface.longDescription: visualize lets agents generate self-contained HTML artifacts — reports, diagrams, diff reviews, slide decks, plans, recaps, dashboards — that read as your brand. Artifact Explore compares responsive document structures while the current visual system and content stay fixed. Brand capture and focused refine verbs work across 35 templates and 103 reference design systems. See https://display.dev/docs/visualize for the full feature set.
